figures.definition_text: Total Income-tax Act depreciation across every mapped block, INCLUDING additions the books show as paid in cash; the Act figure only if that payment mode is shown not to be cash.

findings.title_text: Fixed-asset addition paid in cash over the s.43(1) second proviso limit
limits_text: Books only: the second proviso excludes such payment from actual cost outright, with no Rule 6DD-style exception; confirm no part of the payment was by account payee cheque/draft or ECS before treating the whole addition as cash-paid.
If flagged only via a same-day cash payment to the supplier ledger (not a cash line on this voucher itself), that same-day total may cover more than this one invoice; confirm before excluding.

Both figures are shown: depreciation under the Act applying the proviso (the Act figure if the books' record of cash payment is right), and depreciation including this addition (the Act figure only if the payment is shown not to have been in cash).
ask_client_text: Confirm the mode of payment for this addition in full.
Confirm whether any exception to the second proviso applies.
